def transform(grid):
    # For each row, fill gaps between paired boundary marks only when the
    # enclosing diagonal wedge is locally supported by a mark in adjacent rows.

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        if len(cols) == 2:

            # interior of a V-shaped diagonal outline; fill only cells lying
            # between the inward-facing diagonal arms at that row.
            for c in range(a+1,b):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(cols) == 2:
            pairs = [(cols[0], cols[1])]
        elif len(cols) >= 3:
            # Select the pair tracking the inward edges of the active wedge.
            # Prefer adjacent sorted marks with both endpoints within one cell
            # of a mark in the preceding row; break ties toward the left.
            prev = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r-1]) if v] if r else []
            candidates = [(a,b) for a,b in zip(cols,cols[1:])
                          if any(abs(a-p)<=1 for p in prev) and any(abs(b-p)<=1 for p in prev)]
            pairs = [min(candidates, key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))] if candidates else []
        else:
            pairs = []
        for a,b in pairs:
            for c in range(a+1,b):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
